note.question: Can MC indeed offer a win-win solution that helps both the bottom line and the environment?
note.overview: In high-product-variety businesses like fashion, mass production (MP) systems create environmental waste in the form of overproduction on a colossal scale. Mass customization (MC) has been proposed—without solid evidence—as a solution. In this paper, we analyze whether MC can indeed offer a win-win solution that helps both the bottom line and the environment.

source.quote: Methodology: We develop an analytical model of an MP firm adopting MC (going hybrid).
